cards.name: confirm_sale
cards.spec: When confirm_sale succeeds, the sale's stored total equals the sum of its items' line totals: call sale.calculate_total() and save the sale. A failed confirmation (already confirmed, not enough stock) still changes nothing. Everything else confirm_sale does stays the same.

cards.name: balance_due
cards.spec: balance_due returns the sale's stored total minus amount_paid() as a Decimal, and never less than Decimal('0.00').
